title: Clone mean lies in the unit interval
statement: Let $M>0$, assign to each pair consisting of a variable and one of its $M$ clones a sign in $\{ -1,1\}$, and fix a variable. The uniform mean of its $M$ assigned signs lies in $[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of signs to variable-clone pairs is given
